Guide me through the policy document "Catalunya 2022 - RESET: Crida per reactivar el país".

1. Call get_document_metadata with locale="en" to see the full structure
2. Provide a high-level overview of the 3 spheres and 12 goals
3. Highlight the most impactful proposals across spheres
4. Offer to search specific topics with search_document or drill into any section with get_section

Keep the response organized and suggest next steps for deeper exploration.

Summarize Sphere 1 of the Catalunya 2022 document.

1. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1" locale="en" (the sphere overview)
2. Read the sphere's vision and key themes
3. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1/goal-1" locale="en" (Goal 1)
4. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1/goal-2" locale="en" (Goal 2)
5. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1/goal-3" locale="en" (Goal 3)
6. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1/goal-4" locale="en" (Goal 4)
7. Call list_proposals with sphereId=1 locale="en" (all actions in this sphere)

Synthesize into a comprehensive summary covering:
- The sphere's overarching vision
- Key themes across its goals
- Notable action proposals
- How the goals connect to each other

Analyze Action 2-1 from the Catalunya 2022 document.

1. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1/goal-2/action-2-1" locale="en" (the action itself)
2. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1/goal-2" locale="en" (its parent goal, for context)
3. Call get_section with slug="sphere-1" locale="en" (the sphere it belongs to)

Provide analysis covering:
- Summary of what the action proposes
- How it aligns with its parent goal's objectives
- Key stakeholders involved
- Feasibility considerations
- Cross-references to related actions in other goals
